title: Common Prepositions and the Genitive
lede: Learn what each high-frequency preposition means, how attached prepositions are written, and how the following noun changes without turning the lesson into abstract case analysis.

items.feedback: فِي locates something inside or within a place.
إِلَى marks movement or direction towards a destination.
عَنْ commonly introduces a topic or movement away from something.
The one-letter preposition بِـ attaches directly to the next word.

items.prompt: After فِي, the noun is usually…
items.feedback: A noun governed by a true preposition is genitive.
لِـ attaches to the article: لِلـ, and the noun is genitive.
Company is expressed with مَعَ.
A means of transport commonly follows بِـ.
The topic of speaking follows عَنْ.
A surface relationship uses عَلَى.

items.prompt: Choose the fully supported form: in a school.
items.feedback: An indefinite noun after فِي takes tanwīn kasr in full marking.
The sound masculine plural uses ـِينَ in genitive contexts.
The dual uses ـَيْنِ after a preposition.

options: The preposition governs the noun after it.
Every Arabic word after a preposition is a verb.
items.feedback: The governed noun or pronoun forms a prepositional phrase.
بِـ attaches directly to the article and noun.
لِـ + الـ is written لِلـ.
The established form is لَهُ.
The established form is بِهِ.
Source uses مِنْ.
Topic uses عَنْ.
Attached بِـ and genitive noun.
لِلـ plus genitive noun.
The collocation is استمع إلى.
The collocation is بحث عن.
Dual genitive uses ـَيْنِ.
Sound masculine plural genitive uses ـِينَ.
Company uses مَعَ.
Functional accuracy depends on the whole phrase.

games.e: Location inside/at a place uses فِي.
Direction towards a destination uses إِلَى.
لِـ attaches to الـ as لِلـ.
Sound masculine plural genitive uses ـِينَ.

blocks: ## Why this matters لِمَاذَا نَحْتَاجُ إِلَى حُرُوفِ الْجَرِّ؟
Prepositions make relationships clear: location, direction, source, topic, means, purpose and company.
### Core
Use فِي، إِلَى، مِنْ، عَلَى، عَنْ and مَعَ in short sentences.
### Develop
Control بِـ and لِـ, including بِالـ and لِلـ.
### Stretch
Recognise genitive forms with duals and sound masculine plurals.
[callout] Communication target: describe where you are, where you are going, where you came from, what you are talking about and how you travel.
## Diagnostic start
This is a low-stakes check. Use the feedback to decide which table you need most.
## Meaning first: the common prepositions
Do not choose a preposition because its English translation looks familiar. Choose it because the Arabic relationship is correct.

TABLE: Preposition | Core function | Worked example | Meaning // فِي | inside / in / during | أَدْرُسُ فِي الْمَدْرَسَةِ. | I study at school. // إِلَى | towards / to | أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ. | I go to the library. // مِنْ | from / out of / since a point | عُدْتُ مِنَ السُّوقِ. | I returned from the market. // عَلَى | on / upon / responsibility | الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ. | The book is on the table. // عَنْ | about / away from | تَحَدَّثْنَا عَنِ الرِّحْلَةِ. | We spoke about the trip. // مَعَ | with / in the company of | ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي. | I went with my family. // بِـ | by / with / using | ذَهَبْتُ بِالْحَافِلَةِ. | I went by bus. // لِـ | for / belonging to / intended for | هَذِهِ هَدِيَّةٌ لِصَدِيقَتِي. | This is a gift for my friend.
[callout] Meaning boundary: مَعَ means accompanying someone; بِـ often identifies an instrument, means or method. Compare ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ أَخِي and ذَهَبْتُ بِالْقِطَارِ .
## What happens after a preposition? الِاسْمُ الْمَجْرُورُ
A true preposition governs the noun after it. In fully supported Arabic, this is commonly visible as kasra or tanwīn kasr.
[ar] فِي الْبَيْتِ
[ar] فِي بَيْتٍ
[ar] إِلَى مَدْرَسَتَيْنِ
[ar] مَعَ الْمُعَلِّمِينَ
[callout/warning] Do not overgeneralise: a pronoun attached to a preposition does not show a final kasra in the same way. You learn forms such as فِيهِ، عَلَيْهَا، مِنْهُمْ as complete units.

[callout] Case-ending boundary: This lesson shows the forms that improve reading and accurate modelling. The later Case Endings package will explain the wider system, including nouns that do not take an ordinary kasra.
## Attached prepositions: بِـ and لِـ
These one-letter prepositions join directly to the following word.

TABLE: Build | Correct form | Meaning | Notice // بِـ + حَافِلَةٍ | بِحَافِلَةٍ | by a bus | no space // بِـ + الْحَافِلَةِ | بِالْحَافِلَةِ | by the bus | بِـ joins الـ // لِـ + طَالِبٍ | لِطَالِبٍ | for a student | no space // لِـ + الْطَّالِبِ | لِلطَّالِبِ | for the student | one lām is written in لِلـ // لِـ + هُ | لَهُ | for him / he has | special high-frequency form // بِـ + هِ | بِهِ | with it / by it | pronoun form learned as a unit
[callout/warning] Common spelling errors: Do not write بِ الْبَيْتِ or لِ الْمَدْرَسَةِ with a space. Write بِالْبَيْتِ and لِلْمَدْرَسَةِ .
## Choose the preposition the verb needs
Many Arabic verbs come with a preferred preposition. Store the verb and its preposition together.

TABLE: Expression | Meaning | Model // ذَهَبَ إِلَى | went to | ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ. // عَادَ مِنْ | returned from | عُدْنَا مِنَ الرِّحْلَةِ. // تَحَدَّثَ عَنْ | spoke about | تَحَدَّثَتْ عَنِ الْعَمَلِ. // اِسْتَمَعَ إِلَى | listened to | اِسْتَمَعْتُ إِلَى الْمُوسِيقَى. // اِهْتَمَّ بِـ | was interested in / cared about | أَهْتَمُّ بِالْبِيئَةِ. // بَحَثَ عَنْ | looked for / researched | بَحَثْتُ عَنِ الْمَعْلُومَاتِ.
[callout] Memory method: learn اِسْتَمَعَ إِلَى , not only اِسْتَمَعَ . The collocation is the usable language unit.
## Misconception and proofreading clinic
Repair meaning, attachment and the governed noun form.

TABLE: Incorrect | Correct | Why // أَذْهَبُ فِي الْمَدْرَسَةِ. | أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ. | movement towards a destination // تَحَدَّثْتُ عَلَى الْفِلْمِ. | تَحَدَّثْتُ عَنِ الْفِلْمِ. | the topic follows عَنْ // ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ الْحَافِلَةِ. | ذَهَبْتُ بِالْحَافِلَةِ. | means of transport uses بِـ // هَدِيَّةٌ لِ الطَّالِبُ | هَدِيَّةٌ لِلطَّالِبِ | attach لِـ and use genitive
## Grammar game
Retrieve the preposition that completes each meaning and sentence.
## Skills workshop التَّطْبِيقُ الْعَمَلِيُّ
Apply prepositions in a short message, reading task and spoken description.
[ar] أَنَا فِي مَدْرَسَتِي الآنَ، وَسَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ بَعْدَ الدَّرْسِ.
[ar] ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ صَدِيقَتِي بِالْحَافِلَةِ، وَتَحَدَّثْنَا عَنِ الْعُطْلَةِ.
### Write a practical message
Write 60–80 Arabic words telling a friend where you are, where you are going, who is with you, how you will travel and what you will talk about.
[callout] Success checklist: Use at least six different prepositions; attach بِـ and لِـ correctly; check the noun after each preposition; include one verb–preposition collocation.
[callout] Paper route: Write the message, circle every preposition and draw an arrow to the noun or pronoun it governs.
## Final mastery check
Check meaning, spelling and the noun form after the preposition.
### What you can now do
- Choose a common preposition by meaning rather than translating mechanically.
- Show the genitive after a preposition in supported Arabic.
- Write بِـ and لِـ attached to the following word.
- Use prepositional phrases naturally in everyday communication.
Spaced revisit: Return in two or three days and complete the final check again without looking at the tables.
